answer: Because the lagoon lockup is enforced by the oasis escrow, the forge audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large farm hence freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants pay once per identity. The bond is locked for 22 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. That is 10 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
